about_the_game:
Classic surf re-imagined in the Godot game engine. Free to play and made for everyone.

SurfsUp is a faithful recreation of the community air-surfing that is designed for both veterans and newcomers. Whether you're chasing world records or riding your first ramp, SurfsUp offers precise movement, a competitive feel, and an easy entry point into one of gaming's most iconic experiences.

Features

  • Multiplayer, Your Way

Surf solo or with friends. Join public lobbies or host your own with full control over map selection. Private lobbies are included with the optional Supporter Bundle.

  • Surfing Mechanics

Perfect your technique in high-speed air-surfing. Ride ramps, carve tight turns, and launch massive jumps with precision and flow. It's all about momentum, timing, and control.

  • Daily Map Rotation

A new random set of maps every day keeps sessions fresh and helps you master a wide range of techniques. All maps are included with the optional Supporter Bundle.

  • Classic Surf Maps

Play on iconic maps like Utopia, Boreas, Summit, and Mesa, no unlocks or paywalls. These community classics are always available, letting you sharpen your skills on the maps that helped define the genre.

  • Built in Voice Chat

Teach, trash-talk, or just socialize. Voice is fully integrated into every lobby.

  • Global and Friends Only Leaderboards

Compete worldwide or with your crew. Every run counts.

  • Cosmetic Item Drops

Earn tradable player models and surf animations just by playing.

  • Supporter Bundle DLC

An optional upgrade that unlocks all maps, custom lobbies, unique cosmetics, and supports the future of the game's development.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu LTS or Steam OS
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 (Ivy Bridge), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu LTS or Steam OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 with overclocking
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo SU9400, Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, Metal 3 support (macOS)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8500, Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support, Metal 3 support (macOS)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
